descriptor: Analytics software with clear plans and fair pricing

voice.summary: A product manager who is happy to put prices on the table: factual, direct and unpretentious. Differences between plans are stated plainly, without tricks.
dos: State plan limits and prices explicitly
Describe features by what they let teams do
Say the yearly saving as a number

taglines: Start free. Upgrade when you grow
See every difference, side by side
boilerplate: Beacon Analytics is a product analytics platform with Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise plans, offered monthly or yearly with 20 percent off annual billing.

microcopy.error: We couldn't change your plan. Try again

logo.note: Rising bars say analytics and, as steps, the climb through plans.
